answer.summary: Spring ApplicationContext fails to start because of a circular bean dependency: workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService. The change touches NotificationEventService and WorkflowEndService, so it likely introduced the cycle. This is deterministic, so a rerun will fail the same way. Around 540 of 1042 tests error from the cached context failure, and the AssetLink tests are among them. Fix the dependency cycle and re-run.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
